run_play_scenarios: run the play_scenarios module to play uniform random bots against default scenarios for a specified game
load_game_pyspiel: load a game by name using pyspiel.load_game with a game_name flag argument
create_uniform_random_bots: create uniform random bots for each player in a game using uniform_random.UniformRandomBot
play_bot_in_scenarios: play bots in game scenarios using scenarios.play_bot_in_scenarios with a game and list of bots
define_game_name_flag: define a game_name flag with absl flags to specify which game to play scenarios for
